headline: Names an unnamed Montana mountain peak after Alex Diekmann.
what_it_does: This law officially names a 9,765-foot peak in Montana as the Alex Diekmann Peak. The peak sits about 2.2 miles west-northwest of Finger Mountain, on the western edge of the Lee Metcalf Wilderness. The summary does not describe any changes to land use, access, or rules.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on January 31, 2018.
